evidence_type: independent pre-inference source, identity and retained weight-free evidence review
status: preflight accepted for exact corrected proposal; no ASR result exists

signed_by_role.attestation: I reviewed the original harness and the accounting-only correction, verified the frozen identities and retained regression, and found no remaining material defect for the exact proposed bounded benchmark. This role attestation is not a cryptographic signature.

decision.scope: Root may proceed with the exact prepared argv after its own launch preconditions and current publication check. No alternative models, inputs, prompts, normalization, retries, defaults or gates are approved.
decision.private_exact_argv_binding: The immutable execution proposal hash binds the original private argv. No execution was performed by this evaluator.
decision.run_directory_condition: Proposed fresh run directory was absent at review. Do not overwrite, resume or retry existing output.

canonical_source.launch_note: Runner records actual clean local runtime HEAD at launch. Root separately verifies that HEAD is published and holds core/local/Cargo/models/inputs; unrelated documentation or desktop visual changes do not change these frozen runtime bytes.

identity_audit.model_input_audit_basis: Earlier independent read-only audit verified all six model file pins and all 28 planned WAV/scaled-f32 identities. The final accounting-only recheck did not reopen model weights. Each actual worker rechecks model file pins around load and every WAV hash/decoded buffer before its call.

finding.status: corrected in v2; original defect retained
finding.trigger: Cancellation or deadline occurs while valid call-start/result events remain queued unread.
finding.original_effect: Structured rows falsely claimed unrun despite retained raw evidence of starts/results. It could not create a passing score.
finding.correction: After child launch, missing consumed events produce not_observed_may_have_started. A process that never launched is unrun_process_not_started; later profiles known never launched remain unrun_suite_aborted. Late events are retained raw and never enter scoring.
finding.inspection: Runner diff changes accounting label, explanatory receipt field and matching mock assertions only; no model/scoring/call-loop change.

retained_regression_review.barrier: Synthetic child flushes start 0, result 0, start 1 before parent cancellation.
retained_regression_review.v1_structured_rows: all unrun_profile_aborted; original defective receipt preserved
retained_regression_review.v2_structured_rows: all not_observed_may_have_started with no text or score

reviewed_execution_contract.decoder: actual production CPU Transcriber; English SOT 50257 + NO_TIMESTAMPS 50362, greedy, at most 224 new tokens, existing suppression, no prompt/beam/sample/fallback
reviewed_execution_contract.references: Only the separate weight-free scoring process receives references. Decoder plans contain identities and WAV/model paths, not transcript text.
reviewed_execution_contract.input_binding: One bounded immutable WAV byte buffer is hashed and decoded; decoded f32 SHA/sample count are checked against each fixed plan.
reviewed_execution_contract.network_order: Same-binary reachable loopback and denied control precede profiles. Each actual run verifies denial before model loading. Network controls must pass again at execution, not merely in preparation.
reviewed_execution_contract.write_boundary: Runtime worker sandbox denies writes below model/input roots; outputs are private fresh files. No shared source/model write is part of the code path.
reviewed_execution_contract.fatal_policy: Abort/reap current profile, retain observed and uncertain rows, mark later never-launched profiles unrun; no retries/fallback. A quality failure alone retains the predeclared subsequent fixed profiles.
reviewed_execution_contract.human_acceptance: All 12 scored calls complete and nonempty; corpus errors/279 <= 0.10; every scored warm RTF <= 1.0.
reviewed_execution_contract.v2_acceptance: Separate unchanged licensed-v2 pair; warm WER <= 0.10 and warm RTF <= 1.0; cold text/WER retained as diagnostic, matching the original smoke gate.
reviewed_execution_contract.normalizer: Exact current Rust words() and word_errors() bodies; lowercase, remove punctuation, split whitespace; nine and 9 differ.
reviewed_execution_contract.timing: Complete Transcriber::transcribe API including frontend/encoder/decoder; WAV hashing/decoding and model load excluded from decode timer but included in profile wall time.

reviewed_limits: Source/binary/model file checks are endpoint identities, not an atomic snapshot or continuous protection against external ABA replacement. Model weights are owned buffers after load.
Network-denial evidence concerns runtime worker controls; offline compilation is a separate preparation claim.
Process supervision owns the direct worker group and reaps its child; it is not a general guarantee about detached descendants or arbitrary hostile utility output.
No ASR quality, latency, default-profile choice, live capture, overlap, broad-language, native-UI or reference-parity conclusion exists before the actual fixed run.
Earlier licensed-v2 failures, acquisition/license records, preparation failures and v1 defect evidence remain unchanged.

evaluator_execution.actions: Read/hash source, plans, frozen binaries/files, retained controls and raw synthetic outputs; read current clean Git status and public branch ref only.
